Script.name: ChimeraXP installer
Script.script:
-- ChimeraXP: samodzielny instalator Mudlet (bez polaczenia z GitHubem). -- Instaluje odrebna wtyczke oficjalnej Chimery 5.x, NIE modul ChimeraVIP. -- Kod z tej paczki jest osadzony w pliku XML, bo z prywatnego -- raw.githubusercontent.com zwykle nie da sie pobierac bez autoryzacji.
chimera_xp_installer = chimera_xp_installer or {} local I = chimera_xp_installer I.package_version = "0.5.0-beta.7"
local payload = [==[ -- Chimera AutoExp 5 / standalone plugin for official Chimera 5.x. -- Not compatible with the legacy AutoExp XML package: disable that package. -- Native APIs only: gmcp, mapper, walker and the chimera.* event bus. -- A conservative, opt-in combat PATROL (no unattended loot/selling yet). local function trim(s) return tostring(s or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") end local function normalized(s) return trim(s):lower() end local function bool(v) return v == true or v == 1 or v == "1" end local function pct(value, maximum) local a, b = tonumber(value), tonumber(maximum) if a and b and b > 0 then return a * 100 / b end return nil end local function valid_id(value) return type(value) == "string" and #value > 0 and #value < 128 and not value:find("[%s;\r\n]") end local function contains(name, words) name = normalized(name) for _, pattern in ipairs(words or {}) do if name:find(normalized(pattern), 1, true) then return true end end return false end local function unique_names(raw) local out, seen = {}, {} for _, name in ipairs(type(raw) == "table" and raw or {}) do name = trim(name) if name ~= "" and not seen[normalized(name)] then seen[normalized(name)] = true out[#out + 1] = name end end return out end local function rooms_from(raw) local out, seen = {}, {} for _, room in ipairs(type(raw) == "table" and raw or {}) do local id = type(room) == "table" and room.id or room if valid_id(id) and not seen[id] then seen[id] = true out[#out + 1] = id end end return out end local DEFAULT = { retreatHP = 35, returnHP = 85, maxEnemies = 3, minRoomRevisit = 60, attackWait = 3, syncWait = 4, recoveryPoll = 3, lootGrace = 7, avoidRoomCooldown = 600, escapeWait = 4, escapeMaxTries = 3, safeMoveWait = 3, safeMoveTries = 2, emergencyFallbackSteps = 40 } local function normalize_profile(src, name) local old = type(src) == "table" and src or {} local rules = type(old.rules) == "table" and old.rules or {} local p = { name = trim(name or old.name), route = rooms_from(old.route), targets = unique_names(old.targets), avoid = unique_names(old.avoid), safeRoom = valid_id(old.safeRoom) and old.safeRoom or nil, rules = {}, } for key, default in pairs(DEFAULT) do p.rules[key] = tonumber(rules[key]) or default end return p end local function import_old_profiles(old) local areas = {} for key, profile in pairs(type(old.areas) == "table" and old.areas or {}) do if type(profile) == "table" then local p = normalize_profile(profile, profile.name or key) if p.name ~= "" then areas[normalized(p.name)] = p end end end return areas end
return { name = "autoexp", version = "0.5.0-beta.7", title = "ChimeraXP / AutoExp 5", section = "automatyzacja", description = "Ostrozny patrol PvE oparty na oficjalnym mapperze i GMCP", deps = { "gmcp", "mapper", "walker" }, setup = function(ctx) local gmcp_api = ctx:use("gmcp") local mapper = ctx:use("mapper") local walker = ctx:use("walker") local state = ctx.state local areas = ctx:saved("profiles", {}) if type(areas) ~= "table" then areas = {} end local selected = ctx:saved("selected", nil) local started, paused, dry = false, false, false local phase = "OFF" local mapping = nil local move = nil -- { id, map, purpose } local pending_attack = nil -- { id, room, since } local attacked_in_room = {} local last_seen = {} -- room ID -> time at which room was checked and empty local blocked_until = {} -- room ID -> time until we may try again -- Remember real, GMCP-confirmed routes even when Mudlet's mapped -- getPath() is unavailable or returns a path through an avoided room. -- This is session state only; the history is NOT guessed from exits. local known_exits = state.emergency_known_exits or {} local trail = state.emergency_trail or {} state.emergency_known_exits, state.emergency_trail = known_exits, trail local function record_room(r) if type(r) ~= "table" or not valid_id(r.id) then return end if type(r.exits) == "table" then local links = {} for direction, id in pairs(r.exits) do if valid_id(direction) and valid_id(id) then links[direction] = id end end known_exits[r.id] = links end if trail[#trail] == r.id then return end if #trail >= 2 and trail[#trail - 1] == r.id then table.remove(trail) -- confirmed backtrack, do not bounce back else trail[#trail + 1] = r.id if #trail > 160 then table.remove(trail, 1) end end end local escape = nil -- { origin, sent_at, tries, tried = { cmd = true } } local emergency = nil -- { step = {origin, destination, command, sent_at}, tries, destination } local last_visited = nil local entities_ready = false local observed_room = nil local post_combat_at = nil local last_reason = "" local pending = nil local stop_ours = false local last_group = nil local external_walk = false local evaluate
local function note(message, level) local fn = level == "warn" and ctx.log.warn or ctx.log.info fn(tostring(message)) end local function announce(label) if phase ~= label then phase = label if started then note("AutoExp: " .. phase) end end end local function remember() ctx:save("profiles", areas) ctx:save("selected", selected) end local function allowed_config() if started and not paused then note("Wstrzymaj lub zatrzymaj /exp przed zmiana konfiguracji.", "warn") return false end return true end local function profile() return selected and areas[selected] or nil end local function room() return gmcp_api.room() end local function room_id() local r = room() return r and r.id or nil end local function ready_entities() local packet = gmcp_api.entities() local here = room_id() return entities_ready and type(packet) == "table" and packet.room == here and type(packet.entities) == "table" end local function me_and_group() local members = (gmcp_api.group() or {}).members if type(members) ~= "table" then return nil, nil end local ids, me = {}, nil for _, m in ipairs(members) do if m.id ~= nil then ids[tostring(m.id)] = true end if bool(m.self) then me = m end end return me, ids end local function health() local vitals = gmcp_api.vitals() or {} local hp = tonumber(vitals.hp) local me, group_ids = me_and_group() if hp == nil and me then hp = pct(me.hp, me.maxhp) end local lowest = nil local group = gmcp_api.group() or {} local members = type(group.members) == "table" and group.members or {} for _, m in ipairs(members) do if not bool(m.self) and bool(m.here) then local value = pct(m.hp, m.maxhp) if value and (not lowest or value < lowest.hp) then lowest = { hp = value, name = m.name or tostring(m.id) } end end end return hp, lowest, group_ids, me end local function combat_status(group_ids) local combat = gmcp_api.combat() if type(combat) ~= "table" then return nil, false end local active = bool(combat.self_active) local foreign = false local by_id = {} local packet = gmcp_api.entities() if ready_entities() then for _, e in ipairs(packet.entities) do if e.id then by_id[tostring(e.id)] = e end end end for _, rel in ipairs(type(combat.relations) == "table" and combat.relations or {}) do local a, b = tostring(rel.attacker), tostring(rel.defender) if group_ids and (group_ids[a] or group_ids[b]) then active = true else local ae, be = by_id[a], by_id[b] if ae and be and ( (ae.kind == "player" and be.kind == "npc") or (ae.kind == "npc" and be.kind == "player")) then foreign = true end end end return active, foreign end local function target_info(p, group_ids) if not ready_entities() then return nil, nil end local entities = gmcp_api.entities().entities local found, count = nil, 0 for _, e in ipairs(entities) do local id = e.id and tostring(e.id) or nil local friendly = bool(e.self) or e.relation == "self" or e.relation == "group" or e.relation == "ally" or e.group_role == "leader" or e.group_role == "member" or (id and group_ids and group_ids[id]) if e.kind == "npc" and not friendly and not bool(e.dead) then count = count + 1 if not found and id and valid_id(id) and contains(e.name, p.targets) and not contains(e.name, p.avoid) and not attacked_in_room[id] then found = e end end end return found, count end -- NPCs on the NEXT room are not known from GMCP. On spotting an -- avoided NPC in our current room, leave immediately without issuing -- a combat command. During combat the native walker auto-stops, so -- this escape uses a single direct room exit (GMCP), not walker.go(). local function avoided_npc(p, group_ids) if not ready_entities() then return nil end for _, e in ipairs(gmcp_api.entities().entities) do local id = e.id and tostring(e.id) or nil local friendly = bool(e.self) or e.relation == "self" or e.relation == "group" or e.relation == "ally" or (id and group_ids and group_ids[id]) if e.kind == "npc" and not friendly and not bool(e.dead) and contains(e.name, p.avoid) then return tostring(e.name or e.id or "NPC") end end return nil end -- Commands used by Chimera.Room.Info.exits; other named exits -- ("wrota", "wejscie", etc.) are sent unchanged. local EXIT_COMMANDS = { polnoc = "n", poludnie = "s", wschod = "e", zachod = "w", ["polnocny-wschod"] = "ne", ["polnocny-zachod"] = "nw", ["poludniowy-wschod"] = "se", ["poludniowy-zachod"] = "sw", gora = "u", dol = "d", up = "u", down = "d", } -- Numpad emits chimera.step.manual for any directional send, -- including our ctx:send; ownership lasts only during that call. local owned_direction = nil local expected_manual = nil -- one pending numpad echo of our own step local function send_owned_direction(command) local direction = EXIT_COMMANDS[command] or command -- A "chimera.step.manual" callback may follow ctx:send() instead -- of happening inside it. Keep ONE matching expected event while -- still in the source room (max two seconds). expected_manual = { direction = direction, room = room_id(), time = os.time(), consumed = false, } local previous = owned_direction owned_direction = direction local ok, err = pcall(ctx.send, ctx, command) owned_direction = previous if not ok then expected_manual = nil end return ok, err end local function is_blocked(id) return id and os.time() < (blocked_until[id] or 0) end local function route_path_clear() -- Mudlet getPath() fills speedWalkPath. Never knowingly route -- through a room we just escaped from. for _, map_id in ipairs(type(speedWalkPath) == "table" and speedWalkPath or {}) do local hash = type(getRoomHashByID) == "function" and getRoomHashByID(map_id) or nil if is_blocked(hash) then return false end end return true end local function known_step_toward(r, target, allow_blocked) -- BFS through exits observed in previously visited rooms. Unlike -- the Mudlet map, this needs no saved mapper rooms/coordinates. if not valid_id(target) or r.id == target then return nil end local queue_ids = { r.id } local head, seen = 1, { [r.id] = true } local first = {} while head <= #queue_ids and head <= 600 do local id = queue_ids[head] head = head + 1 local links = (id == r.id and r.exits) or known_exits[id] if type(links) == "table" then local options = {} for direction, dest in pairs(links) do local command = EXIT_COMMANDS[direction] if command and valid_id(dest) and not seen[dest] and (allow_blocked or not is_blocked(dest)) then options[#options + 1] = { command = command, id = dest } end end table.sort(options, function(a, b) if a.id == b.id then return a.command < b.command end return a.id < b.id end) for _, link in ipairs(options) do seen[link.id] = true first[link.id] = id == r.id and link or first[id] if link.id == target then local result = first[link.id] return result.command, result.id end queue_ids[#queue_ids + 1] = link.id end end end return nil end local function emergency_step(p, r) -- Priority 1: direct GMCP way to the saved safe room. No map needed. local direct, dest = known_step_toward(r, p.safeRoom, false) if direct then return direct, dest, "GMCP" end
-- Priority 2: Mudlet getPath. Some clients have only a partial -- mapper graph, or mapper.current_room() updates after Room.Info. local from = type(getRoomIDbyHash) == "function" and getRoomIDbyHash(r.id) or mapper.current_room() if type(from) ~= "number" or from <= 0 then from = mapper.current_room() end local safe = type(getRoomIDbyHash) == "function" and getRoomIDbyHash(p.safeRoom) or nil if from and safe and safe > 0 and type(getPath) == "function" then local ok, found = pcall(getPath, from, safe) if ok and found and route_path_clear() then local path = type(speedWalkPath) == "table" and speedWalkPath or {} local next_id = type(getRoomHashByID) == "function" and getRoomHashByID(path[1]) or nil if valid_id(next_id) and not is_blocked(next_id) then for direction, hash in pairs(type(r.exits) == "table" and r.exits or {}) do local command = EXIT_COMMANDS[direction] if command and hash == next_id then return command, hash, "mapper" end end end end end
-- Priority 3: retrace confirmed rooms, not a guessed route. -- Two last trail rooms: [..., previous, current]. if trail[#trail] == r.id and #trail >= 2 then local previous = trail[#trail - 1] if not is_blocked(previous) then for direction, hash in pairs(type(r.exits) == "table" and r.exits or {}) do local command = EXIT_COMMANDS[direction] if command and hash == previous then return command, hash, "cofanie" end end end end
-- Priority 4: when neither safe route nor breadcrumb exists, an -- actual GMCP exit is safer than standing still in lethal combat. -- Avoid known dangerous rooms and loops; never invent an exit. local options = {} for direction, id in pairs(type(r.exits) == "table" and r.exits or {}) do local command = EXIT_COMMANDS[direction] if command and valid_id(id) and not is_blocked(id) then local n = emergency and emergency.visits[id] or 0 options[#options + 1] = {command=command, id=id, visits=n or 0} end end table.sort(options, function(a,b) if a.visits ~= b.visits then return a.visits < b.visits end if a.id ~= b.id then return a.id < b.id end return a.command < b.command end) if #options > 0 then return options[1].command, options[1].id, "wyjscie GMCP" end return nil end local function escape_exit(p, r, tried) local exits = type(r.exits) == "table" and r.exits or {} local options = {} local position = 0 for i, hash in ipairs(p.route) do if hash == r.id then position = i; break end end -- Prefer an adjacent room further along the mapped patrol. local priority = {} for step = 1, #p.route do local index = ((position + step - 1) % #p.route) + 1 local hash = p.route[index] if hash ~= r.id and priority[hash] == nil then priority[hash] = step end end for exit, hash in pairs(exits) do local command = EXIT_COMMANDS[exit] or exit if valid_id(hash) and valid_id(command) and not is_blocked(hash) and not tried[command] then options[#options + 1] = { command = command, id = hash, rank = priority[hash] or 1000, } end end table.sort(options, function(a, b) if a.rank ~= b.rank then return a.rank < b.rank end return a.command < b.command end) if #options == 0 then return nil end
-- A direct route neighbour is ideal. If we cannot step directly -- onto the patrol route, prefer the FIRST step toward a waypoint. if options[1].rank < 1000 then return options[1].command end local from = mapper.current_room() if from and type(getPath) == "function" then for step = 1, #p.route do local index = ((position + step - 1) % #p.route) + 1 local hash = p.route[index] local dest = not is_blocked(hash) and getRoomIDbyHash(hash) or nil if dest and dest > 0 and dest ~= from and getPath(from, dest) and route_path_clear() then local path = type(speedWalkPath) == "table" and speedWalkPath or {} local next_hash = type(getRoomHashByID) == "function" and getRoomHashByID(path[1]) or nil for _, option in ipairs(options) do if option.id == next_hash then return option.command end end end end end -- Even without a mapped route ahead, try a non-blocked exit. return options[1].command end local function queue(delay) if not started or paused or pending then return end pending = ctx:timer(delay or 0, function() pending = nil if started and not paused then evaluate() end end) end local function halt(reason) expected_manual = nil if pending then ctx:cancel(pending); pending = nil end started, paused, dry = false, false, false phase, pending_attack, move, escape, emergency = "OFF", nil, nil, nil, nil post_combat_at = nil last_reason = reason or "Zatrzymano" if stop_ours == false and state.owns_walk then stop_ours = true walker.stop("AutoExp: stop") stop_ours = false end state.owns_walk = false note("AutoExp: " .. last_reason) end local function pause(reason) if not started or paused then return end expected_manual = nil paused = true phase = "PAUSED" last_reason = reason if pending then ctx:cancel(pending); pending = nil end if state.owns_walk then stop_ours = true walker.stop("AutoExp: pauza") stop_ours = false end state.owns_walk = false move, pending_attack, escape, emergency = nil, nil, nil, nil note("AutoExp WSTRZYMANY: " .. reason, "warn") end local function move_to(id, purpose) local current = mapper.current_room() local destination = type(getRoomIDbyHash) == "function" and getRoomIDbyHash(id) or nil if not current or not destination or destination <= 0 then pause("Brak lokacji na mapie: " .. tostring(id)) return false end if current == destination then return true end if state.owns_walk then return false end move = { id = id, map = destination, purpose = purpose } state.owns_walk = true -- BEFORE go: native walker emits synchronously announce(purpose == "safe" and "RETREAT" or "MOVING") local ok, reason = walker.go(destination) if not ok then move, state.owns_walk = nil, false pause("Chodzik odmowil ruchu: " .. tostring(reason)) return false end if ok == "tutaj" then move, state.owns_walk = nil, false queue(0) end return true end local function escape_avoided(p, r, name) local now = os.time() if not escape or escape.origin ~= r.id then escape = { origin = r.id, tried = {}, tries = 0 } blocked_until[r.id] = now + math.max( tonumber(p.rules.avoidRoomCooldown) or DEFAULT.avoidRoomCooldown, tonumber(p.rules.minRoomRevisit) or DEFAULT.minRoomRevisit) pending_attack, post_combat_at = nil, nil note("AutoExp: omijany NPC (" .. name .. ") - opuszczam lokacje!", "warn") end if state.owns_walk then stop_ours = true walker.stop("AutoExp: wyjscie z lokacji z omijanym NPC") stop_ours = false state.owns_walk, move = false, nil end if escape.sent_at and now - escape.sent_at < (tonumber(p.rules.escapeWait) or DEFAULT.escapeWait) then announce("AVOID_ESCAPE") return end if escape.tries >= (tonumber(p.rules.escapeMaxTries) or DEFAULT.escapeMaxTries) then pause("Nie udalo sie opuscic lokacji z omijanym NPC: " .. name) return end local command = escape_exit(p, r, escape.tried) if not command then pause("Brak dostepnego wyjscia z lokacji z omijanym NPC: " .. name) return end if dry then note("AutoExp TEST: omijam " .. name .. " -> " .. command) pause("Zakonczono test - zadnej komendy nie wyslano") return end escape.tries = escape.tries + 1 escape.tried[command] = true escape.sent_at = now announce("AVOID_ESCAPE") local ok, err = send_owned_direction(command) if not ok then pause("Blad wyslania kroku omijania NPC: " .. tostring(err)) end end -- Emergency retreat: the official walker deliberately stops on combat. -- Issue ONE mapped direction at a time and await Room.Info confirmation. -- This cannot overcome a server-side ban on fleeing from combat. local function retreat_in_combat(p, r) if not valid_id(p.safeRoom) then pause("Niskie HP w walce, ale nie zapisano bezpiecznej lokacji (/exp bezpieczna)!") return end if r.id == p.safeRoom then emergency = nil announce("RECOVERY") return end if state.owns_walk then stop_ours = true walker.stop("AutoExp: awaryjny odwrot w walce") stop_ours = false state.owns_walk, move = false, nil end local now = os.time() if not emergency then emergency = { destination = p.safeRoom, tries = 0, steps = 0, fallback_steps = 0, visits = { [r.id] = 1 }, warned_fallback = false } pending_attack, post_combat_at, escape = nil, nil, nil note("AutoExp: ALARM HP! Awaryjny odwrot do bezpiecznej lokacji, krok po kroku.", "warn") end if emergency.step and emergency.step.origin == r.id then if now - emergency.step.sent_at < (tonumber(p.rules.safeMoveWait) or DEFAULT.safeMoveWait) then announce("EMERGENCY_RETREAT") return end if emergency.tries >= (tonumber(p.rules.safeMoveTries) or DEFAULT.safeMoveTries) then pause("ALARM: serwer nie potwierdzil ruchu w walce! Przejmij sterowanie natychmiast.") return end -- Retry the same mapped exit; switching destinations while -- the previous movement may be delayed is too risky. emergency.tries = emergency.tries + 1 emergency.step.sent_at = now note("AutoExp: ruch niepotwierdzony; powtarzam wyjscie do bezpiecznej lokacji (" .. emergency.tries .. "/" .. p.rules.safeMoveTries .. ").", "warn") announce("EMERGENCY_RETREAT") local ok, err = send_owned_direction(emergency.step.command) if not ok then pause("Blad powtorzenia kroku awaryjnego: " .. tostring(err)) end return end -- A new room is now confirmed. Plan just the next step, not a -- multi-command speedwalk that might race against GMCP combat. emergency.step, emergency.tries = nil, 0 local command, next_id, source = emergency_step(p, r) if not command then pause("ALARM: brak potwierdzonego, dostepnego wyjscia GMCP podczas odwrotu! Przejmij sterowanie!") return end if source ~= "GMCP" and source ~= "mapper" then if emergency.fallback_steps >= (tonumber(p.rules.emergencyFallbackSteps) or DEFAULT.emergencyFallbackSteps) then pause("ALARM: przekroczono limit szukania schronienia bez znanej trasy. Przejmij sterowanie!") return end emergency.fallback_steps = emergency.fallback_steps + 1 if not emergency.warned_fallback then emergency.warned_fallback = true note("AutoExp ALARM: brak drogi do schronienia; cofanie/wyjscie awaryjne (" .. source .. ").", "warn") end else emergency.fallback_steps = 0 -- known route; do not cap long safe routes end if dry then note("AutoExp TEST: awaryjny odwrot w walce -> " .. command) pause("Zakonczono test - zadnej komendy nie wyslano") return end emergency.step = { origin = r.id, destination = next_id, command = command, sent_at = now } emergency.tries = 1 emergency.steps = emergency.steps + 1 announce("EMERGENCY_RETREAT") local ok, err = send_owned_direction(command) if not ok then pause("Blad wyslania kroku awaryjnego: " .. tostring(err)) end end local function select_next(p, current) local route, now = p.route, os.time() local position = 0 for i, id in ipairs(route) do if id == current then position = i; break end end -- Cykl stabilny: nie przeliczamy 200 tras przy kazdym GMCP. local minimum_wait = nil for step = 1, #route do local idx = ((position + step - 1) % #route) + 1 local id = route[idx] local revisit = last_seen[id] and (last_seen[id] + p.rules.minRoomRevisit) or 0 local eligible_at = math.max(revisit, blocked_until[id] or 0) if now >= eligible_at then if id ~= current then local dest = getRoomIDbyHash(id) local from = mapper.current_room() if from and dest and dest > 0 and getPath(from, dest) and route_path_clear() then return id end else -- A one-room or otherwise exhausted route should -- wait for respawn instead of stopping permanently. minimum_wait = minimum_wait or p.rules.minRoomRevisit end else local remaining = math.max(1, eligible_at - now) if not minimum_wait or remaining < minimum_wait then minimum_wait = remaining end end end return nil, minimum_wait end local function maybe_record(room_info) if not mapping or not room_info or not valid_id(room_info.id) then return end if not mapping.seen[room_info.id] then mapping.seen[room_info.id] = true mapping.route[#mapping.route + 1] = room_info.id end end evaluate = function() local p = profile() local r = room() if not p or not r or not valid_id(r.id) then pause("Brak profilu lub lokacji GMCP") return end -- Guard against triggering on stale room/Entities after a fast move. if observed_room ~= r.id then observed_room, entities_ready = r.id, false attacked_in_room = {} last_visited = os.time() end local hp, weakest, group_ids = health() if not hp then announce("WAIT_HP"); return end local danger = hp <= p.rules.retreatHP or (weakest and weakest.hp <= p.rules.retreatHP) local active, foreign = combat_status(group_ids) -- When low HP forces retreat while in combat, safety takes -- precedence over ordinary avoided-NPC routing and attacking. if emergency or (danger and active) then retreat_in_combat(p, r) return end -- Apply avoid even if already attacked; the game may have started -- combat before Room.Entities arrived. Never call zabij here. local forbidden = avoided_npc(p, group_ids) if forbidden then escape_avoided(p, r, forbidden) return end if escape and escape.origin == r.id and escape.sent_at and os.time() - escape.sent_at < (tonumber(p.rules.escapeWait) or DEFAULT.escapeWait) then -- Movement was sent; await room change before resuming patrol. announce("AVOID_ESCAPE") return end if escape and escape.origin == r.id then escape = nil end if active == nil then announce("WAIT_COMBAT"); return end if danger then if active then retreat_in_combat(p, r) return end if r.id ~= p.safeRoom then if dry then note("AutoExp TEST: odwrot -> " .. tostring(p.safeRoom)) pause("Zakonczono test - zadnej komendy nie wyslano") return end -- A running retreat is already heading to safety. -- Do not stop/restart it on every vitals/timer callback. if state.owns_walk and move and move.purpose == "safe" then announce("RETREAT") return end if state.owns_walk then stop_ours = true walker.stop("AutoExp: odwrot") stop_ours = false state.owns_walk = false move = nil end move_to(p.safeRoom, "safe") return end announce("RECOVERY"); return end if active then pending_attack = nil post_combat_at = nil announce("COMBAT") return end if phase == "COMBAT" then post_combat_at = os.time() announce("POST_COMBAT") end if post_combat_at then -- The official collect module sends several commands on kill;
